description: Update environment configuration, finalize UI components, and update documentation. Add all new environment variables to .env.example with clear comments. Verify toast notifications work across all pages. Add API token management UI. Update README.md and IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md to reflect completed features. Create missing documentation for new features.
steps: Review .env.example: ensure all new env vars added in previous FEATs are present with clear comments: REDIS_URL, PUSHER_*, RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, AWS_*, STORAGE_PROVIDER

Review lib/env.ts: ensure all new env vars properly validated in envSchema with correct types (string, url, enum) and .optional().or(z.literal('')) pattern for optional vars. Verify features object includes new features.
Verify components/ui/toast.tsx is properly integrated: check that ToastProvider wraps app in app/layout.tsx, test toast.success/error/warning/info from any page
Update app/(app)/settings/api-tokens/page.tsx (created in FEAT-005): polish UI, add copy-to-clipboard button for tokens, add last-used-at column, add confirmation dialog for revoke
Create components/realtime-status.tsx: indicator showing Pusher connection status (connected/disconnected/reconnecting) for debugging. Add to app shell header for admins only.
Update IMPLEMENTATION_ROADMAP.md: mark completed phases (2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, 5.1, 6.1) as COMPLETED. Update percentage complete from 85% to 95%. Remove 'In Progress' workflows section.

Update README.md: add Real-time Features section documenting Pusher integration, add API section with link to docs/API.md, update feature list to include REST API and S3 storage, update status table to 95% complete
Create docs/API.md: comprehensive API documentation with authentication, rate limits, all endpoints with request/response examples, error codes, SDKs/client examples in curl, JavaScript, Python
Create docs/REDIS.md: document Redis caching strategy, TTLs, cache keys, invalidation rules, performance impact, monitoring
Create docs/STORAGE.md: document S3 setup, local fallback, file types, retention policy, cleanup jobs, CORS configuration
Update docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md: add sections for Redis setup (Redis Cloud, Upstash, self-hosted), Pusher setup, Resend setup, S3 setup with detailed steps
Run full verification: npm run verify (lint, typecheck, test, build). Fix any errors found.
Create CHANGELOG.md: document all new features added in this implementation with version 1.1.0 release notes
acceptance_criteria: Toast notifications working on all pages
API token management UI complete and user-friendly
All documentation up to date and accurate
Deployment guide covers all new services
verification: npm run verify - all checks pass (typecheck, lint, test, build)
Review .env.example - all new vars present with helpful comments
Visit any page - trigger toast notification - verify it appears and auto-dismisses
Visit /settings/api-tokens - verify UI is polished and functional
Read through all updated documentation - verify accuracy and completeness
Follow deployment guide steps for one service (e.g., Pusher) - verify instructions work
Review CHANGELOG.md - verify all features documented
Check README.md feature list - verify all implemented features listed
